verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own AI Snippets let users define email templates once, for phrases, paragraphs or whole emails, and reuse them individually or across a team. Variable-like `{AI placeholders}` are filled in automatically by the AI. Nothing in the evidence shows snippets carrying attachments, and the variables are AI-filled instructions rather than documented user-defined merge fields. missing for 10: attachment support in snippets, documentation of user-defined variables or merge fields and how snippets are inserted, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply

citations.quote: AI Snippets let you define an email template once upfront and then re-use it whenever you need it.
You can define email templates for commonly used phrases, paragraphs, or even entire emails.
You just need to add instructions using `{AI placeholders}` and the AI will automatically fill them out.
AI Snippets are available both for individual use and for use across your team.
